spark_output.note: Sentinel until run completes; overwritten by RPA with the spark code

retrieval.primary: POST /api/v1/automation/taskLogList with task_id from taskList (Scheduled Task Report)

retrieval.note: taskList may lag; callback is most reliable if the phone can reach your server URL (not localhost unless tunneled).
